name: io.github.themudhaxk/mudbase-mcp-server
title: Mudbase
description: Collections, documents, search and file storage for a Mudbase backend.

environmentVariables.name: MUDBASE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mudbase project API key (starts with ak_). Create it in the Mudbase console under your project's API Keys settings.

environmentVariables.name: MUDBASE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the API base URL. Only needed for a self-hosted or non-default deployment.
